title: reqQuest Framework Ownership — Role Catalog (roles.yaml)
description: Machine-readable projection of the human-facing stakeholder catalogue. Source of truth for the ownership validator (V1/V4/V5) and the CODEOWNERS generator. Contract defined in ADR-GOV-001.

version.description: Optional schema-consumer version of this catalogue (major.minor).

roles.description: Map form is mandatory: the key IS the role id, which structurally guarantees uniqueness. List form is rejected — the stdlib parser (_parse_simple_yaml) silently drops the nested fields of a list-of-mappings without raising. See ADR-GOV-001, section 'Empirical evidence'.

propertyNames.description: Role id: lowercase kebab-case, e.g. role-maintainer, role-tech-lead.

handle.description: Host handle: @user or @org/team. Username part allows '.' and '_' (valid on GitLab, e.g. @alice.smith); GitHub uses a subset. Verified against the host only at level `enforce` (rule V6).

title.description: Human-readable role name, mirrored from the stakeholder prose (K2).

handle.description: One handle, or a list of handles (flat variant — the whole team owns everything).

responsible_for.description: Directories under requirements/ this role owns, relative to the repo root. `*` means the whole requirements/ tree (flat variant). Two roles claiming the same directory is a hard error on GitHub (last-match-wins) — rule V5.

min_permission.description: Lowest host permission a handle must hold for this role. Consulted only at level `enforce` (rule V6); declared at every level so intent is recorded before it is enforced.

min_approvals.$comment: Optional, GitLab-only (section [Name][N]). Honoured on GitLab, ignored with a warning on GitHub where the approval count is repo-global, not per-path (ADR-GOV-001 D8). Accepts a string form because the stdlib parser _parse_simple_yaml returns every scalar as a string — the Phase 1 validator coerces it. Added to the schema now so extending roles.yaml later does not break existing adopters.
